hook: A conjecture about balls inside shapes fails in three or more dimensions, where the radius r/2 is optimal.
hook_turn: where the radius r/2 is optimal.
summary: The strong union of uniform closed balls conjecture, recently proved in the plane, is false in every dimension n of 3 or more. The author builds compact sets from simplices whose circumcenter and incenter coincide, containing a point outside every ball of radius slightly above r/2. This shows the known radius r/2 cannot be improved in high dimensions, unlike the planar value r/sqrt(3).
title: A counterexample to the strong version of the union of uniform closed balls conjecture in dimensions three and higher
